description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySession component, specifically testing WebSocket connection behaviors, token handling, invoke request handling, and other gateway session functionalities in an Android environment using Robolectric, Kotlin coroutines, and mockwebserver.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore storing tokens in-memory, used for testing token management logic.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class encapsulating a GatewaySession, its Job, and a device auth store, used for setting up test scenarios.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: A data class holding the GatewaySession.InvokeRequest and its result parameters, used to capture the outcome of invoke tests.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Test class containing multiple unit tests for GatewaySession behaviors, including connection logic, token handling, invoke request processing, and capability updates.

methods.name: connect_usesBootstrapTokenWhenSharedAndDeviceTokensAreAbsent
methods.description: Verifies that the connection uses a bootstrap token when no stored device tokens are available.

methods.name: connect_prefersStoredDeviceTokenOverBootstrapToken
methods.description: Ensures that the connection prefers stored device tokens over bootstrap tokens if present.

methods.name: connect_retriesWithStoredDeviceTokenAfterSharedTokenMismatch
methods.description: Tests retry logic with stored device tokens after a token mismatch error occurs during initial connection.

methods.name: connect_storesPrimaryDeviceTokenFromSuccessfulSharedTokenConnect
methods.description: Checks that primary device tokens are stored after a successful connection using a shared token.

methods.name: bootstrapConnect_storesAdditionalBoundedDeviceTokensOnTrustedTransport
methods.description: Verifies storage of additional device tokens received during bootstrap over a trusted transport.

methods.name: nonBootstrapConnect_ignoresAdditionalBootstrapDeviceTokens
methods.description: Ensures that non-bootstrap connections ignore additional bootstrap device tokens.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_roundTripsInvokeResult
methods.description: Tests that a node invoke request correctly receives and processes an invoke result payload.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_usesParamsJsonWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that invoke requests correctly handle provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_mapsCodePrefixedErrorsIntoInvokeResult
methods.description: Verifies that code-prefixed errors are correctly mapped into the invoke result structure.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability_sendsObjectParamsAndUpdatesScopedUrl
methods.description: Tests the refresh process for node canvas capabilities, ensuring parameters are sent and URL is updated accordingly.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Creates a Json instance configured to ignore unknown keys, used across tests.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Sets up a test harness with a GatewaySession, job, and device auth store for testing.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Function to initiate a connection to the gateway node with specified parameters.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for connection establishment or throws an assertion error if timeout occurs.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up session, job, and server after a test completes.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Executes a test scenario simulating invoke requests and processes responses, capturing results.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for connect response frames, with optional canvas URL and auth JSON.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Sets up a mock WebSocket server to simulate gateway behavior during tests.
